motion.name: mobile-drawer
motion.purpose: Mobile drawer opening and closing; reduced motion is respected.

components.name: Working Tray
components.description: A structural dark seam groups adjacent task cells.

components.name: Application Cell
components.description: One app's identity, status, facts, and actions in one place.
components.css: .ds-app{min-height:15rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:1.25rem;border-radius:0.65rem;background:var(--tray-cell,#fffdfa);color:var(--foreground,#22352f);font:0.875rem 'Noto Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-app h3{margin:2rem 0 0;font-size:1.3rem}.ds-app p{margin:0.2rem 0 1rem;color:var(--muted-foreground,#53665d)}.ds-app-state{align-self:flex-end;padding:0.2rem 0.5rem;border-radius:0.35rem;background:#ddefe3;color:#18583d;font-size:0.75rem}.ds-app-fact{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding:0.75rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border,#dce5da)}.ds-app button{align-self:flex-start;margin-top:auto;padding:0.5rem 1rem;border:0;border-radius:0.5rem;background:var(--primary,#294d3f);color:#fff;cursor:pointer}.ds-app button:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}.ds-app button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#3e7760);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Binding Cell
components.description: Structured data identity and individual database names, never a CSV line.

components.name: Form Group
components.description: One related decision in a soft compartment, with aligned controls.
components.css: .ds-form-group{display:grid;gap:1rem;padding:1.3rem;border-radius:0.7rem;background:var(--tray-soft,#f1f5ed);color:var(--foreground,#22352f);font:0.875rem 'Noto Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-form-group h3{margin:0;font-size:1rem}.ds-form-group p{margin:0.2rem 0 0;color:var(--muted-foreground,#53665d)}.ds-form-group label{display:grid;gap:0.4rem}.ds-form-group select{width:100%;height:2.75rem;padding:0 0.75rem;border:1px solid var(--input,#ccd8cb);border-radius:0.55rem;background:var(--card,#fff);color:var(--foreground,#22352f)}.ds-form-group select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#3e7760);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact pine action; disabled and pending states stay beside the affected resource.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A full-track input that shares height with selects.

narrative.overview: Bento is a functional way of arranging work, not a food illustration. A visible tray frame divides the workspace into distinct compartments. Cell size follows the importance of the content: stack condition and exceptions lead; applications each own a box; data bindings reveal the actual service, user, databases, and path without collapsing into a text line. In forms, compartments group fields by the decision being made. The visual is calm and friendly, but its geometry does the organizing.
keyCharacteristics: The dark tray seam groups neighboring cells without adding decorative shadows.
One resource per application or binding cell, with its state and actions inside the same cell.
Form groups contain one related decision: identity, runtime, routing, data, or resources.
Color and icon reinforce a textual state; neither substitutes for it.

rules.name: The Compartment Rule
rules.body: A colored rectangle earns its place by containing a complete task or resource, not by displaying a lone metric.

dos: Do let the compartment arrangement reveal what belongs together and what deserves attention.
Do keep an action and its pending/error state beside the resource it affects.
Do keep destructive confirmations, retained-data descriptions, and add-only binding behavior exact.
donts: Don't substitute a flat applications table or CSV-like database line for resource compartments.
Don't use a thick frame on every individual control, or decorative bento food imagery.
Don't mix unrelated fields or let select widths depend on their option text.
